prediction.confidence_reason: This is the materially different disclosure-timing field explicitly allowed after the rejected 10-K/10-Q early-filing tests: SEC NT late-filing notices from EDGAR submissions are free, PIT, and production-visible. The edge is contrarian absorption, but late filings can be genuine accounting/control risk, so expected success is low.
